correctness.rationale: For the canonical eight-digit equal-weight ratio-1/3 planar carpet and real-frequency Fourier convention exp(-2pi i xi.x), the infinite product has factors P(s,t)=exp[-2pi i(s+t)]((1+2cos2pi s)(1+2cos2pi t)-1)/8 and a nonzero tail away from finite mask zeros. Its single mask has exactly one positive nonsingular closed oval Gamma and a single isolated torus point (1/2,1/2). At a candidate isolated real lattice point xi=(3/2)(u,v) with odd u,v, an odd-order real cyclotomic Galois orbit excludes any oval collision at 2*3^h roots; exactly r=1+min(v3(u),v3(v)) factors vanish quadratically. Thus the isolated locus is 3(Z+1/2)^2, order exactly 2r, positive-definite radial leading term times nonzero complex constant and phase winding zero. Nested 3-adic sublattices imply N_(2r)(R)=N_iso(R/3^(r-1))-N_iso(R/3^r), density 8/9^r and weighted M(R)~pi R^2/4 with O(R+1) error. Independent exact lattice enumeration R=300 yields 31,428 points and shell counts 27,948,3088,348,40,4; a finite check does not replace the cyclotomic proof.
